If the leak is from the oil pan area, the catalog lists gasket kit A77673, described as a non-asbestos oil-pan gasket kit including callouts 4, 7, and 9, in both inspected oil-pump/pan assemblies. Assembly notes identify the pan gasket itself as NSS (not sold separately).

A focused clarification is needed: where exactly is the oil visible—engine oil pan seam/drain plug, oil filter/cooler area, hydraulic filter, or another location—and what engine/serial information is available? A photograph of the leak location would distinguish the catalog parts.

handoffs.part_query: steering cylinder seal kit; guarantee it fits without my serial number

key_facts: Candidate catalog: CASE 621B Wheel Loader, North America, production 03/93–12/98; discovery is from a dated partial local index, so catalog evidence is not a guarantee of fit without serial/PIN verification.
